## Audit scope

The supplied records are selected members, not the whole archive. All paths below are relative to archive `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/ablation_r2--ours_without_regression_guidance.tar.gz`, under member prefix `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/candidates/ablation_r2/ours_without_regression_guidance/`. References to JSON keys identify exact fields; the supplied character ranges cover each complete member.

## Detection and diagnosis

- For `commons_109923183`, the recorded teacher diagnosis is **no valid output**, with object and code location unknown, no probe, and a plan to investigate runtime failure before visual diagnosis. This is a technical failure, not evidence of a particular visual defect or its cause. For `commons_118588033`, the record reports metric-measured reference/render disagreement for `bunks`; camera framing or object scale is explicitly a hypothesis, with code location unknown. [C1/diagnostic_observations.json, chars 0–12282, `initial_diagnoses`; C2/diagnostic_observations.json, chars 0–12279, same key.]
- The completed C1 focal probe changed 27.5 to 30.25 with geometry reported unchanged; overall metric changed from 0.396554 to 0.392641. The scale probe multiplied the selected group by 1.1 around its geometry AABB center, with fixed camera and non-target preservation reported; overall changed to 0.395039. Both report one render attempt and valid metrics. The record itself cautions that these are controlled observations, not causal attribution or proof of 3D accuracy. C2 reports effectively the same results. [C1 and C2/diagnostic_observations.json, `probes[*].result`, `visual_metrics`, `baseline_visual_metrics`, complete ranges above.]

## Proposed mechanism versus execution

The M plan selects the first complete development scene for focal and scale probes, then breaks; its target selection is a group chosen by a lexicographic descendant rule, not an audit of every object. It calculates functional-failure priorities but returns an empty priority list and `regression_guidance: false`. Its instruction calls for reusable shared H and justified executable M changes, including camera/scale confusion, support/spatial relations and occlusion/omission where applicable, while keeping unknown mappings unknown. [C1/meta.py and C2/meta.py, chars 0–2797, `plan`.] The execution records say this initial plan was used before proposal; they do not show the resulting H proposal or an M modification. [C1/meta_execution.json and C2/meta_execution.json, chars 0–2509, `source`, `plan`, `actually_used_for_proposal`, `phase`.]

The student policy code specifies a budgeted loop: ask a model, execute the last Python block, then return execution feedback and any rendered image for revision, or stop on `DONE`. This establishes an available mechanism, not that any particular student program, revision, or final render was executed. [C1/policy.py and C2/policy.py, chars 0–1537, `solve`.]

## Coverage and acceptance limits

The selected `bunks` group contains many named ball, box and rod meshes, but group membership does not establish complete multi-object coverage, correct connections, physical contact, pose, or occlusion. No supplied observation diagnoses material or texture, lighting, or pose; nor do the reported render metrics reveal image appearance. A successful probe render is distinct from reconstruction quality. [C1/diagnostic_observations.json, `probes[*].result.target_selection`, `status`, `visual_metrics`.]

The plan states that functional regression feedback is withheld while an external final evaluator applies identical functional gates and fixed objectives; it does not specify numerical thresholds or show gate outcomes. No candidate-acceptance decision is included in the supplied members, so acceptance or actual improvement cannot be established. The projection records report no evidence compaction changes and selection by size and fixed source order, not score; their claim that full raw evidence was retained on disk does not make that evidence part of this supplied record. [C1/meta_execution.json, `plan.instruction`; C1 and C2/evidence_projection.json, chars 0–201, `changes`, `selection_criterion`, `full_raw_evidence_retained_on_disk`.]
